run_structure_generator: run the StructureGenerator to create adsorbate slab placements and write VASP input files for a given bulk surface and adsorbate
precompute_slabs: precompute slab surfaces for a list of bulk indices and save them to a directory for later use
generate_heuristic_placements: generate heuristic adsorbate placements on a slab surface using the AdsorbateSlabConfig class in heuristic mode
generate_random_placements: generate random adsorbate placements on a slab surface with configurable rotation modes and augmentation count
write_surface_vasp_inputs: write VASP input files and metadata pickle for a slab surface to the output directory structure
